result.reason: The clause gives Client the required successor-assignment right and applies a reasonableness standard to consent, but it still permits Vendor to assign freely to a financially responsible affiliate and does not prohibit assignment to a Client competitor. It therefore reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback, which requires consent for assignments other than successor assignments. The edits are otherwise limited and preserve unrelated intent, although the placement of the notice qualifier is somewhat ambiguous as to whether it applies only to Client successor assignments or also to affiliate assignments.
